measurementDefinitions.bladePx: Guard plane at the blade shoulders to the blade tip along the weapon axis.
measurementDefinitions.fullHiltPx: Guard plane to the furthest pommel end along the weapon axis.
measurementDefinitions.exposedGripPx: Usable wrapped grip between guard structure and pommel collar.
measurementDefinitions.guardWidthPx: Maximum functional quillon span perpendicular to the weapon axis; decorative aura does not count.
measurementDefinitions.pommelPx: Pommel and terminal cap length along the weapon axis.
measurementDefinitions.overallPx: Blade tip to pommel end; must equal bladePx plus fullHiltPx within one pixel.

constructionRules: The exposed grip accommodates exactly two gauntleted hands plus modest separation and is not a staff-like handle.
The grip has an oval or gently waisted section with believable wrap, collars, tang alignment, and a compact counterweight pommel.
The functional guard sits at the blade shoulders; high-rank ornament cannot move the apparent guard plane down the blade.
Blade width and mass taper toward the tip; no rectangular slab, paddle, or uniform-width bar.
Every rank uses the same numeric envelope even when material and ornament change.
reviewRule: Every rank must have explicit landmark measurements, derived ratios recomputed by the campaign validator, and a pass in every required range before the board can be presented for acceptance.
